*[[2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests]]
**At least 80 [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment factories]] in [[Savar Upazila|Savar]] and [[Ashulia]], [[Bangladesh]], declare general holidays after workers stage [[sit-in]]s and [[Strike action|work stoppages]] over [[minimum wage]] demands, while [[Bangladesh Police|police]] announce that 96 people, including five [[trade union|labour]] leaders, have been arrested in connection with the 4 November clashes on the [[N5 (Bangladesh)|Dhaka–Aricha Highway]].
